summaryTemplate.instructions:
Summarize what was discussed in the meeting. Keep it concise, factual, and neutral. Capture key points, decisions, blockers, and next steps. Include direct quotes only when they add clarity or context.

Use well formatted bullet points under the section headers. ASCII only. Each line = new bullet.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Two sentences to three sentences summarizing what happened with minimal formatting.

sections.title: Participants + Context
sections.content:
* Who attended
* Purpose of the meeting
* Relevant background or prior context

sections.title: Key Discussion Points
sections.content:
* Main topics covered
* Important details shared
* Notable quotes (optional)

sections.title: Decisions Made
sections.content:
* Agreements, approvals, or resolved items
* Ownership for each decision

sections.title: Open Questions / Issues
sections.content:
* Items needing clarification
* Risks, blockers, or concerns raised

sections.title: Action Items & Next Steps
sections.content:
* Tasks, owners, and deadlines
* Follow-ups required
* Dependencies or required inputs

sections.title: Rapport
sections.content: * Rapport details - anything personal about who they are, what they like, where they are, etc.

summaryTemplate.instructions:
Keep each section concise and actionable. Prioritize: pains, workflow gaps, buying triggers, and next steps. Pull in exact quotes where useful. Highlight any numbers, tools, timelines, or commitments they mention. Focus on information that advances qualification, forecasting, or the close.

Write bullet points in each section. Keep bullets brief with no filler words. Be concise.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Two sentences to three sentences summarizing what happened with minimal formatting.

* Company overview (industry, size, GTM motion)

* Key quotes (their words)

sections.title: Pain + Use Cases

* Desired outcomes
* Specific use cases they emphasized

sections.title: GTM Tech Stack

* Supplementary tools (enrichment, dialer, sequences, reporting, notes)
* What they like / dislike
* Identified gaps

sections.title: Competition / Alternatives

sections.title: BANT

* Need: Severity + urgency
* Timeline: Renewals, deadlines, internal constraints

sections.title: Misc.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.content:
* Action items
* Owners (you/them)
* Dates + commitments
* Dependencies (data export, stakeholder loop-in, trial setup)
